method.unicode_unit: Unicode code points; in Python len over Unicode strings. Grapheme clusters/display glyphs may contain multiple code points.
method.newline_normalization: CRLF and CR normalized to LF for measurement; source text not modified.
method.url_rule: Remove recognized https?:// non-whitespace URL strings before counting tags and body length. No URL occurred in 182 measurement inputs.
method.tag_rule: A whitespace-delimited token beginning with ASCII # and at least one following character is one tag; exact strings only; no spelling or punctuation merging.
method.base_body_rule: Normalize CRLF/CR to LF; remove recognized product URL strings; remove all displayed whitespace-delimited hashtag tokens for body length. If all tokens from the first hashtag to the end are hashtags, remove the preceding separator and an immediately preceding standalone UI label タグ:. Preserve other whitespace, punctuation and linefeeds.
method.supplement_body_rule: Use body_full, removing inline hashtag tokens and URL strings using the same rule. Tags stored separately are not included in body codepoint length.
method.supplement_tag_rule: Use saved tags array entries beginning with ASCII #; compare against embedded body_full tags. Do not double-count duplicate representation.
method.quartiles: Sort ascending; linear interpolation at p*(n-1), p=.25/.50/.75. n=0 gives null statistics; n=1 gives the sole value for all statistics.
method.reaction_rule: All 132 base rows and all 50 G05 rows included; reaction state does not filter or weight analysis.
method.readback_rule: Source text is read only as input to length/tag measurement; saved-body readback is not a collection count condition.

edge_case_checks.expected_and_observed: n=0 returns null summary; n=1 returns the single observed value for min/Q1/median/mean/Q3/max. No observed measurement row is silently dropped for either case.
edge_case_checks.emoji_and_unicode: Base source contains supplementary-plane codepoints in 117 rows and G05 body_full in 43 rows; counted by Unicode code point, not grapheme. Source body values were not emitted.
